slice: Separate immutable gyro-only rotation trajectory and CPU indexed parallel point compensation, with explicit reference timestamps.
api: ImuSeries.rotation_trajectory(start_ns,end_ns,*,gyro_bias,max_gap_s=0.05) -> ImuRotationTrajectory. Identity rotation gauge at start; copied knots/frame/bias; rotation(stamp_ns), deskew(points,i64_times,reference_ns,*,imu_from_lidar,parallel=False). No position/velocity/gravity state API.
motion_model: Held body gyro minus declared fixed bias on [t_k,t_(k+1)). Exact clipped integer-ns differences; independent fixed-knot point queries. IMU origin fixed within each compensated scan. Full IMU-from-LiDAR R/t includes rotation-induced LiDAR lever-arm displacement. IMU-origin translation is unmodeled, not estimated zero velocity or physical full deskew.
validation: Only gyro must be usable on integrated left samples; acceleration and reported orientation are ignored including missing/invalid values. Complete bracketing, positive finite gap, same frame on closing samples, finite proper rotations and results, first indexed error, no extrapolation or point sorting. Serial/parallel output bits must match.

real_component.coverage: reject entire first scan; all remaining 185 scans / 4,440,000 points in source order
real_component.reference_time: maximum checked integer point timestamp, t in ns from exact header
extrinsics: SciPy exp([0.2,-0.1,0.3]) with translation [0.5,-0.3,0.2] numerical lever-arm control
real_component.oracle: Independent standard ROS1 reader + SciPy held-gyro exponentials and NumPy rigid transforms; no acceleration or reported attitude

real_startup.comparison: Same saved old undeskewed poses/diagnostics; new gyro-compensated raw points before all range/source/insertion filtering; no additional odometry deskew or IMU prediction.

evidence: Freeze controller before execution and exact Rust/Python inputs before build; preserve every successful prior protocol/controller/binary/snapshot/receipt verbatim. Compare unchanged full trajectory/frontend regressions on the new native.
scope: No timing, GPU, physical accuracy/calibration claim, ground-truth parsing, acceptance-limit changes, default changes, fitted initial velocity/gravity or feedback into the frontend. Zero gyro bias is declared, not calibrated.
